title: 6.4 Transformations of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

icans: I can describe transformations of exponential and logarithmic functions.
I can find the asymptote and domain of a transformed function.
I can write a rule for a transformed exponential or logarithmic function.

vocab: g(x) = a · bˣ⁻ʰ + k: _____________ asymptote y = k
g(x) = a · log_b(x − h) + k: vertical ____________ x = h, domain x > h

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Exponential transformations: For g(x) = a · bˣ⁻ʰ + k, the horizontal asymptote is _______________.

blocks.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = 4ˣ represented by g(x) = 4ˣ⁻³ + 1. Give the asymptote of g.

notes: Reflections: a < 0 reflects the graph in the _______________; a negative x reflects it in the _______________.

blocks.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = (½)ˣ represented by g(x) = −(½)ˣ − 3. Give the asymptote of g.

notes: Logarithmic transformations: For g(x) = a · logb(x − h) + k, the vertical asymptote is _______________ and the domain is _______________.

blocks.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = log₂ x represented by g(x) = log₂(x + 4) − 2. Give the asymptote and domain of g.
Describe the transformation of f(x) = 3ˣ represented by g(x) = 3ˣ⁺² − 5. Give the asymptote of g.

tickets.stem: Describe the transformation of f(x) = 2ˣ represented by g(x) = 2ˣ⁻¹ + 3.
What is the asymptote of g(x) = 5ˣ − 4?
